test_title: PYST 33: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 19 Feb, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The organization _________ a major campaign to promote sustainable living last year.
solution:
The correct answer is '**launched**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
__ 
 
• The verb "**launched**" is the simple past tense form of the verb "**launch**." 
 
• The sentence describes an action that occurred in the past ("**last year**"), so the past tense "**launched**" is required. 
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and 4 are grammatically incorrect in this context. 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**. 
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"The organization **launched**__ a major campaign to promote sustainable living last year."* 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 
 
 
• **Option 1: "launching"** is incorrect because it is the present participle form and does not fit the past tense context. 
 
• **Option 2: "launches"** is incorrect because it is the present tense form and does not fit the past tense context. 
 
• **Option 4: "launch"** is incorrect because it is the base form of the verb and does not fit the past tense context.
